messages:
Nina (Demand): Quick ask  webinar is locked for 2026-04-12. Need X + LinkedIn teaser plan with two creative tracks: "numbers" (perf chart + stat) and "human" (customer quote). Also need two 4-tweet microthreads, one LinkedIn long post, hero image, 20s clip, and a GIF. We want to A/B CTA: Register vs Watch recording. Can we map routing to SDRs for comment/DMs?

Omar (Social): I can run the queues. Suggest cadence: X numbers -> 2026-04-08 15:00 UTC, LinkedIn human -> 2026-04-09 18:00 UTC, X human -> 2026-04-10 15:00 UTC, LinkedIn numbers -> 2026-04-11 18:00 UTC. Will pin reg link as top reply for 48h. Shortlink: rdw.ai/web0426.

Bea (Content): I'll draft both threads + LinkedIn long copy and three quick reply templates (info, technical, SDR handoff). Upload ETA: 2026-04-01 14:00 PT to /Marketing/Events/webinar-apr-2026/assets. Assets: hero_1200x628.png, clip20s_v1.mp4 (silent), gif_v1.gif. Keeping clip music-free for licensing.

Ravi (Growth): Routing plan: Zapier -> HubSpot. Pipeline name: webinar_social_apr26. Intent rules: regex /(pricing|demo|enterprise|trial|rfp)/i => high-intent. If profile contains company domain or follower_count>700 => medium. Auto-DM exact-match demo/pricing: "Thanks! Please DM your work email or register rdw.ai/web0426 and our SDR will follow up." UTM: utm_source=twitter|linkedin&utm_campaign=webinar_apr26&utm_content={variant}. I'll push the Zap mapping today.

ops-bot: Reminder: Confirm clip consent and any partner logo permissions by 2026-04-02. Maintenance window 2026-04-07 08:00-12:00 UTC; avoid scheduling then. Registration consent checkbox is enabled.

Omar (Social): Engagement play: two follow-ups within 24h. 1) reply with extra stat + slide image, 2) reply with CTA to register/book. We'll mute obvious spam and set a simple filter for replies containing URLs not matching rdw.ai. Also we'll brief 3 internal advocates to amplify on 4/09 morning.

Bea (Content): Reply templates (choose per signal): - Low: "Thanks! Register: rdw.ai/web0426  recording sent to registrants." - Tech Q: "Great Q  we'll cover routing and perf tradeoffs in the demo. Slides: rdw.ai/slides0426" - Sales handoff: "Sounds like a fit  can our SDR reach out? DM your email or register and we'll prioritize follow-up."

Nina (Demand): Solid. Action items: Bea uploads assets by 4/1 14:00 PT; Omar to queue posts and share scheduling links; Ravi to publish Zapier mapping; ops-bot confirm licenses by 4/2. Quick check 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Thanks! :rocket:
